ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated along the continuous trailing edge and the median notch. Contiguous dark geometric blobs (mottling) are present in the lower-medial section of the right lobe and scattered across the central area of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a symmetrical upward curve from the insertion point to the distal tips, with a sharp posterior sweep at the outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of a cluster of 4-6 high-contrast circular white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions; specifically, three distinct parallel diagonal rake marks on the left lobe and smaller, scattered linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge topography and deep median notch suggesting cumulative physical trauma or wear; presence of distinct linear rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense dark pigmentation zone extending vertically from the fluke insertion through the median notch toward the trailing edge.
